common.toggle_theme: Switch between light and dark theme
common.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

overview.blocked_sub: Already resolved by ModSecurity: kept here, no alert
overview.modules_all_ok: All the enabled modules are working
overview.activity_help: The blue part of each bar is what ModSecurity blocked. Click an hour to search its events.

register.title: Registration
register.text: localSIEM has no open registration. The accounts are created by an administrator in Administration › Users.

recover.title: Forgotten password
recover.text: Ask an administrator of localSIEM to reset your password in Administration › Users. On the server, root can also run: /opt/localsiem/venv/bin/python /opt/localsiem/webapp/backend/manage.py reset-password USERNAME

mfa.verify_help: Type the 6-digit code that your authenticator app shows for «PYMEHackers localSIEM».
mfa.setup_required: Two-step verification is mandatory. Add localSIEM to your authenticator app and type its first code.
mfa.qr_alt: QR code to add localSIEM to the authenticator app
mfa.scan_help: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, FreeOTP…). It will show as «PYMEHackers localSIEM».
mfa.manual_help: If you cannot scan it, type this key in the app (time-based, 6 digits, 30 seconds):

search.histogram_help: Drag over the bars (or click one) to narrow the time range. The blue part of each bar is what ModSecurity blocked.
search.no_results: No results in this time range.

help.intro: Words search the original text (full text). Combine terms with AND (implicit), OR, NOT or a leading -, and parentheses. Text fields ignore case.
help.ip: Everything from one IP, from every source.
help.rule: Requests that matched a CRS rule.
help.combined: SQL injections that were not blocked and got a 200 answer.
help.wildcard: Wildcards: any URI that contains wp-login.
help.phrase: Exact phrase in the original text (also URL-encoded).
help.alert: The requests of one SOC alert, by its code.
help.fields: Fields: ip, vhost, host, method, uri, path, query, status, bytes, duration, ua, referer, uid, module, source (access/error/audit), rule, category, phase, score, engine (on/detection-only), severity, action (blocked/none), alert, sent (yes/no), parse (ok/partial/unparsed).

query.query_missing_term: A term is missing after an operator
query.query_invalid_range: The start of the range is greater than its end
query.query_invalid_number: This field needs a number, a comparison or a range

card.doubtful_block: 403 answer without any trace of ModSecurity: it is not counted as a block of ModSecurity.
card.weak_correlation: Weak correlation: the access line has no UNIQUE_ID, so the sources were joined by IP, path and time.
card.db_error: A database error appeared in error.log for this request.
card.detail_dropped: Headers and body were not stored: the disk was almost full.

live.filter_placeholder: Same syntax as the search, e.g. action:none rule:*
live.help: New events appear on top as soon as the collector stores them (after the 5-second correlation window). Click a row to see its request card.

alerts.help: One alert per module, vhost, IP, category and severity in each time window. Click a row to see what was sent to the SOC.

alert_error.soc_not_configured: There was no SOC configured (or sending to it was turned off): the alert stays in localSIEM and is never sent.

account.must_change: This password was generated for you: choose your own before you go on.
account.totp_on: On. The code comes from your authenticator app («PYMEHackers localSIEM»).
account.totp_pending: Pending: it is set up at the next sign-in.
account.totp_disabled: Off on this server. An administrator can turn it on in Administration › Settings.
account.reset_totp: Set up the authenticator app again
account.reset_totp_help: Your session will close and the next sign-in will show a new QR code. Type your password to confirm.

users.title: Accounts
users.help: Every account signs in with its password and two-step verification. Generated passwords are shown once and must be changed at the first sign-in.
users.username_help: 2 to 64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens, underscores or @.
users.new_password_help: Give this password to {user} through a safe channel. It is shown only now.
users.reset_password_confirm: Generate a new password for {user}? Their sessions will close.
users.reset_totp_confirm: Reset the two-step verification of {user}? They will set it up again at the next sign-in.
users.delete_confirm: Delete the account {user}? This cannot be undone.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.help: An access token lets an analyst open their dashboard straight from a URL, https://<this server>:10443/auth/login/auto?token=..., without password nor second factor, from the allowed IPs. Only analyst accounts can have one. Each token expires and can be revoked; it is shown only when it is created.
tokens.user_help: Only active analyst accounts: administrators always sign in with password and second factor.
tokens.label: Label
tokens.label_help: Optional: what the token is for (for example «SOC alerts»).
tokens.created_help: Give this URL to {user}: it opens their dashboard without password nor second factor. It is shown only now. Whoever has it can sign in as {user} from the allowed IPs until it expires or is revoked.
tokens.revoke_confirm: The token of {user} stops working at once. The sessions it already opened end when they expire.
tokens.no_analysts: There is no active analyst account: create one first (Accounts).

sources.title: Sources
sources.collector_missing: The collector has not started yet (service localsiem).
sources.rediscover: Discover again and run the doctor
sources.doctor_help: Requirements of each module. localSIEM never changes the Apache configuration by itself: each missing requirement comes with the snippet to add (or, as root, manage.py setup-modules --configure-apache).

modules.help_admin: Each module reads the logs of one service of this server. Here you turn them on and off, open one to configure it (its settings, its sources, its doctor and its rules), update it when the repository has a newer version and uninstall the ones you no longer need. New ones are installed in the Installable tab.
modules.help_user: Each module reads the logs of one service of this server. Only an administrator can turn them on and off or configure them.
modules.collector_stopped: The collector is not running (service localsiem): no module is reading anything now.
modules.switch_label: Turn the module {module} on or off
modules.locked_help: It cannot be turned on until this server has what the module needs: install it and press Reconfigure in the page of the module.
modules.disable_confirm: Turn off the module {module}? localSIEM stops reading its logs and sending its alerts until it is turned on again. What is already stored stays.
modules.uninstall_confirm: Uninstall the module {module}? localSIEM deletes /opt/localsiem/modules/{id}/ and stops reading its logs and sending its alerts. The events already stored stay, and so do its settings, in case you install it again.
modules.uninstall_not_restarted: The collector did not answer: restart the localsiem service so that it stops using the module.
modules.checking_updates: Checking the repository for newer versions…
modules.updates_failed: The repository could not be checked for newer versions: {error}
modules.update_notice: The repository has version {version} (the installed one is {installed}).
modules.update_incompatible: The repository has version {version}, but it needs localSIEM {core} or newer: update localSIEM to install it.
modules.update_confirm: Update {module} from version {installed} to {version}? localSIEM downloads the new version from the repository, swaps it for the installed one and restarts the collector. Its settings are kept, and the module stays on or off as it is.
modules.updated_detail: {module} went from version {previous} to {version}: the collector loads the new version within a few seconds. Its settings are kept.
modules.update_root_needed: The new version reads other logs or has another setup option. So that localSIEM can read them, run this command as root on this server:
modules.update_not_restarted: The collector did not answer: restart the localsiem service so that it loads the new version.
modules.collector_not_notified: Saved, but the collector did not answer: it applies it when it starts.
modules.saved_applying: Saved. The collector applies it now.
modules.reading: Reading {reading} of {total} sources · {lines} lines in the last hour
modules.none: No modules installed. An administrator installs them in Modules › Installable.
modules.none_admin: Install modules from the Installable tab.
modules.settings_none: This module has no settings of its own.
modules.disabled_no_sources: The module is off: it reads no sources.
modules.doctor_help: Requirements of the module. localSIEM never changes the configuration of the server by itself: each missing requirement comes with the snippet to add.
modules.doctor_none: The doctor has not run yet.
modules.disabled_no_doctor: The module is off: the doctor does not run.
modules.setup_hint: To have these requirements applied for you ({option}), run this command as root on this server (it also lets localSIEM read the logs of the modules and restarts it):
modules.requirements_help: What this server must have before the module can be turned on. Installing the module never installs it: install it, correct the settings if needed (for example, where its configuration file is) and press Reconfigure.
modules.reconfigure_met_off: The requirements of the module are met and its switch is unlocked: turn it on when you decide. localSIEM never turns it on by itself.
modules.reconfigure_met_on: The requirements of the module are met. The collector is discovering its sources again and running its doctor.
modules.reconfigure_missing: Some requirements are still missing: install what Requirements lists and press Reconfigure again.
modules.reconfigure_root: So that localSIEM can read the logs of the module, also the ones created after installing it, run this command as root on this server:
modules.rules_help: Rules of this module, evaluated on every event. A disabled rule stops generating alerts; the threshold and the window only apply to the threshold and sequence rules.

catalog.title: Installable modules
catalog.intro: Modules of the localSIEM-modules repository (GitHub) that are not installed on this server yet: they are installed only here. localSIEM downloads the one you choose, checks it and loads it within a few seconds. Installing a module never installs the software it watches.
catalog.all_installed: Every module of the repository is already installed.
catalog.action_invalid: The module of the repository is not valid
catalog.installed_detail: {module} {version} is installed: the collector loads it within a few seconds.
catalog.installed_off: {module} {version} is installed, turned off: this server lacks what it needs, and installing a module never installs the software it watches:
catalog.reconfigure_hint: Once you have installed it, open the module in the Installed tab (Configure) and press Reconfigure: when it finds it, you can turn the module on.
catalog.root_needed: So that localSIEM can read the logs of the module, run this command as root on this server (it gives the localsiem user read access to the logs of the modules and restarts localSIEM):
catalog.setup_hint: Add {option} to the command to also apply the requirements of the module to its service.
catalog.collector_not_restarted: The collector did not answer: restart the localsiem service to load the module.

module_reason.collector_stopped: The collector is not running (service localsiem).
module_reason.not_loaded: Installed after the collector started: restart the localsiem service.
module_reason.applying: The collector is applying the change.
module_reason.source_unreadable: A source cannot be read (permissions of the localsiem user).
module_reason.source_missing: A source does not exist yet.
module_reason.requirements_missing: This server lacks what it needs:

skipped.format_without_data: its format has no data: every line is the same text (a LogFormat nickname that is not defined)

disk.low: Low: bulky detail is no longer stored
disk.critical: Critical: only alerted events are stored

soc.optional_help: The SOC is optional. Without one (or with the sending turned off), localSIEM keeps its alerts here as «Not sent» and never sends them later: once a SOC is configured, only the new alerts go to it.
soc.token_help: Created by an administrator of the SOC for this client; it is shown only once there. Leave it empty to keep the current one.
soc.ca_help: Only for a SOC with a private certificate (test servers). TLS is always verified.
soc.test_failed: The SOC did not accept the heartbeat: {error}
soc.address_help: In the SOC, set this as the SIEM address of this client: it is the link the analyst uses to investigate here.
soc.allow_help: Add the outgoing IPs of the SOC to the allowed IPs (Settings), and allow them in the firewall too.

channels.general_help: Besides delivering every alert to the SOC, localSIEM sends through the channels the alerts of the chosen severity or above. A channel sends nothing until it is set up and turned on in its own section.
channels.enabled_help: Turned off, no channel sends anything, whatever its own setting.
channels.min_severity_help: The alerts of this severity or above are sent through the channels.
channels.language_help: Language of the texts of the messages; the rule and the description of the alert stay as localSIEM wrote them.
channels.list_help: State of each channel, as the collector reports it. Open a channel to set it up.
channels.all_off: All the channels are turned off: turn them on in
channels.telegram_enabled_help: It needs the token of the bot and the chat id.
channels.telegram_token_help: The one @BotFather gives when the bot is created: <id of the bot>:<secret>. Leave it empty to keep the current one.
channels.telegram_chat_id_help: Who receives the messages: the numeric id of your chat with the bot, of a group (it starts with -) or of a channel (it starts with -100), or the @username of a public channel or group.
channels.telegram_test: Save and send a test message
channels.telegram_test_ok: {bot} sent the test message. Check that it arrived.
channels.telegram_test_failed: Telegram did not accept the test message: {error}
channels.telegram_remove_token_confirm: The token of the bot is deleted from this server and the Telegram channel is turned off. The bot itself is not deleted.
channels.telegram_step_1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and follow its steps. Copy the token it gives you into «Token of the bot».
channels.telegram_step_2: Open the chat with your new bot and press Start (or add the bot to the group, or as an administrator of the channel, that will receive the messages). A bot cannot write to anyone who has not spoken to it first.
channels.telegram_step_3: Find the chat id: send any message to the bot and open https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates in a browser; the id is the number after "chat":{"id":. For a public channel you can use its @username.
channels.telegram_step_4: Write the chat id, tick «Send the messages through Telegram» and press «Save and send a test message».
channels.telegram_step_5: In General, choose the minimum severity of the alerts that are sent and the language of the messages.
channels.telegram_network: The server needs to reach https://api.telegram.org (outgoing port 443). If Telegram does not answer, each message is tried again a few times; the messages waiting are lost if localSIEM restarts (the SOC always gets every alert).

settings.max_disk_help: 0 = the lesser of 15 % of the disk and 10 GB. The oldest events are deleted first; localSIEM never fills the disk.
settings.allow_from_help: One per line. Empty: the web is open to any address (not recommended). Applied to the whole web, sign-in included; 127.0.0.1 is always allowed.
settings.mfa_enabled: Two-step verification (2FA) mandatory for every account
settings.mfa_enabled_help: Off by default. Once on, every account sets up the authenticator app («PYMEHackers localSIEM») at its next sign-in, and the sessions of the accounts that have not set it up yet close. The access tokens of the analysts never ask for it.
settings.mfa_turn_on_confirm: Every account will have to use an authenticator app. The accounts that have not set it up yet, yours included if that is the case, will be signed out now and will set it up at their next sign-in.
settings.mfa_turn_off_confirm: The accounts will sign in with their password only. The authenticator apps already set up are kept, and they will be asked for again if you turn it back on.
settings.group_window_help: One alert per module, vhost, IP, category and severity in this window.
settings.group_buffer_help: Gathers the burst before the first alert of a group leaves. Critical alerts leave at once.
settings.correlation_window_help: Time a request waits for its access, error and audit records before it is evaluated.
settings.below_threshold_help: CRS matches whose score stayed below the anomaly threshold (often false positives of the application).
settings.no_rules: The collector has not loaded the rules yet.
settings.rules_moved: The rules are configured in each module: Modules › Configure.

audit.help: Who searched what and when. The logs hold personal data (IPs, URLs), so every search and export is recorded.

logins.help: Every sign-in to localSIEM, with password or with an access token, and every failed attempt.

errors.network_error: localSIEM cannot be reached. Check the connection.
errors.login_blocked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.challenge_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.passwords_differ: The new passwords do not match.
errors.password_too_short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.last_admin: There must be at least one active administrator.
errors.cannot_change_self: You cannot disable, demote or delete your own account.
errors.csrf_failed: The request was refused for security. Reload the page.
errors.authentication_required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.collector_not_ready: The collector has not created the database yet.
errors.collector_unreachable: The collector (service localsiem) does not answer.
errors.search_timeout: The search took too long. Narrow the time range or the query.
errors.invalid_range: The start must be before the end.
errors.invalid_url: The URL must start with https://
errors.invalid_allow_from: One of the allowed IPs is not a valid IP or CIDR.
errors.allow_from_excludes_you: Your address ({ip}) would not be allowed: add it to the list first.
errors.query_syntax: The query has a syntax error.
errors.requirements_missing: The module cannot be turned on: this server lacks what it needs.
errors.module_not_loaded: The module does not load: its error is shown in Modules.
errors.download_failed: The repository of modules cannot be downloaded. Check the connection of this server to GitHub.
errors.invalid_archive: The archive of the repository is not valid.
errors.archive_too_big: The archive of the repository is too big.
errors.invalid_ref: Invalid branch or tag of the repository of modules.
errors.module_not_found: That module is not in the repository.
errors.invalid_module: The module of the repository is not valid.
errors.install_running: Another module is being installed. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.install_failed: The module could not be written to /opt/localsiem/modules. Read the log of the web (service localsiem-web).
errors.uninstall_failed: The module could not be deleted from /opt/localsiem/modules. Read the log of the web (service localsiem-web).
errors.token_invalid: That access link is not valid. Ask the administrator for a new one.
errors.token_expired: That access link has expired. Ask the administrator for a new one.
errors.token_revoked: That access link was revoked. Ask the administrator for a new one.
errors.token_needs_analyst: Access tokens are only for analyst accounts.
errors.invalid_days: Choose a validity between 1 and 365 days.
errors.invalid_chat_id: Invalid chat id: a number (it can start with -) or an @username.
errors.invalid_bot_token: Invalid token of the bot: it must be <id of the bot>:<secret>, as @BotFather gives it.
errors.telegram_incomplete: Telegram needs the token of the bot and the chat id before it can be turned on.
errors.telegram_token_missing: Save the token of the bot first.
